name: sybil-eclipse
title: Sybil → Eclipse
blurb: T+10s five Sybils graft in and flood; P4 scoring prunes them in two heartbeats. T+16s peer-10 is eclipsed by silent attackers scoring cannot see. T+24s faults clear.
